            10    may it please the Court:

            11             If you read the Helms-Burton Act from

            15    crushing diplomatic and economic pressure on

            16    the Cuban government.  That includes by

            17    abrogating the sovereign immunity of Cuban

            18    instrumentalities in claims brought under Title

            19    III of that Act.

            20             Now there's admittedly a high bar for

            21    abrogation, but this Court has said again and

            22    again that Congress doesn't need to use magic

            23    words to get there.  It just needs to make its

            24    intent clear through what Kirtz called the sum

            25    total of its work, and it did that here.

             1             Let me start with the most important
